mods.title: Fendt 900 Vario Series
mods.author: Schnibbl Modding
mods.description:
Fendt 900 Vario Series Gen6
Base price: 262,656 $
Power: 296 hp

Fendt 900 Vario Series Gen7
Base price: 266,500 $
Power: 296 hp

Configurations:
- Tire configuration
- Beacon Lights
- Warning Signs
- Main Body Color
- Rim color
- Design
- Line

Engine configuration:
- Vario 930 (296 hp)
- Vario 933 (326 hp)
- Vario 936 (355 hp)
- Vario 939 (385 hp)
- Vario 942 (415 hp)

Animation (Mouse control):
- The door can be opened/closed by pressing both mouse buttons left/right
- The rear window can be opened/closed with the push of the two mouse buttons backwards/forwards
- The roof window can be opened/closed with the mouse wheel

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- Indicators placed in the correct position
- Light set to correct position
- Animated fan
- Added Power, Power+, Profi and Profi+
- Fixed visual flaws
- Added Fendt 900 Vario Gen6
- Addes isoBus function

Changelog 1.1.1.0:
- added 'interactive control' support (Requires 'FS22_interactiveControl')
- 'mouse control' or 'interactive control' can be configured (for consoles)

Changelog 2.0.0.0:
- Fixed steering console (Only when playing without 'Interactive Control')
- Fixed left beacon when not selected
- Completely new interior decals in the 900 Gen6
- Decals in the 900 Gen7 completely revised
- Added Darkmode for both generations
- Halogen or LED configuration for the light package
- New tractor sound

Changelog 2.0.0.1:
- Added realistic rims
- Fixed some smaller issues
